title: Shopping starts with AI, so our store must be built for agents too
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); 34% of US shoppers would use GenAI for gift ideas (Gartner). Walmart opened to outside agents and added spending limits; Amazon widened Shop Direct. PC shipments fell 21% in Q3 (Counterpoint).

points.headline: Retailers are setting rules for AI shopping agents
points.detail: Walmart added agent profiles, terms and spending limits; Amazon expanded Shop Direct to keep shoppers off outside agents. We should decide how agents may read and buy from our store.

points.headline: AI is now a mainstream discovery channel
points.detail: NIQ finds 55% of consumers use AI in discovery; Gartner says 34% of US shoppers would use GenAI for gift ideas. Product content must work for AI tools.

points.headline: PC demand is sharply weaker as memory costs bite
points.detail: Counterpoint: Q3 shipments fell 21%, with Q4 forecast down 27%. Apple raised iPad mini prices on memory costs. We should plan Q4 promotions, pricing and inventory accordingly.

points.headline: Apple moves into touchscreen laptops
points.detail: Apple showed its first touchscreen laptops, priced at the premium end. We should check how our touch-capable lines are positioned online against them.
